questions.question: How many chapters (Surahs) are in the Quran?
questions.explanation: The Quran has 114 Surahs (chapters).

questions.question: What is the first Surah of the Quran?
questions.explanation: Al-Fatiha is the opening chapter of the Quran.

questions.question: In which month was the Quran revealed?
questions.explanation: The Quran was first revealed to Prophet Muhammad in the month of Ramadan.

questions.question: Who brought the Quran to Prophet Muhammad?
questions.explanation: Angel Jibril (Gabriel) brought the revelation of the Quran to Prophet Muhammad.

questions.question: What is the longest Surah in the Quran?
questions.explanation: Al-Baqarah (The Cow) is the longest Surah with 286 verses.

questions.question: What is the shortest Surah in the Quran?
questions.explanation: Al-Kawthar is the shortest Surah with only 3 verses.

questions.question: How many verses are in Al-Fatiha?
questions.explanation: Al-Fatiha has 7 verses and is recited in every prayer.

questions.question: What does 'Quran' mean?
questions.explanation: Quran means 'The Reading' or 'The Recitation'.

questions.question: In which language was the Quran revealed?
questions.explanation: The Quran was revealed in Arabic.

questions.question: How many parts (Juz) is the Quran divided into?
questions.explanation: The Quran is divided into 30 Juz (parts) for easier reading.

questions.question: How many verses (ayahs) are in Surah Al-Fatiha?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Fatiha, the opening of the Quran, has 7 verses.

questions.question: What is the last Surah of the Quran?
questions.explanation: Surah An-Nas is Surah number 114, the last Surah of the Quran.

questions.question: What does the word 'Quran' mean?
questions.explanation: Quran comes from an Arabic word meaning recitation or reading aloud.

questions.question: What do we call a person who has memorized the whole Quran?
questions.explanation: A Hafiz is someone who has memorized the entire Quran by heart.

questions.question: What do we say before starting to read the Quran?
questions.explanation: Before reading the Quran, we seek protection from shaytan by saying A'udhu billah, then Bismillah.

questions.question: To whom was the Quran revealed?
questions.explanation: The Quran was revealed to Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) through Angel Jibril.

questions.question: What is the printed book of the Quran called?
questions.explanation: A Mushaf is the written or printed copy of the Quran.

questions.question: How should we treat the Quran?
questions.explanation: We treat the Quran with great respect because it is the word of Allah.

questions.question: Which night is better than a thousand months, according to the Quran?
questions.explanation: Laylat al-Qadr (the Night of Power) in Ramadan is better than a thousand months.

questions.question: What was the first word of the Quran revealed to Prophet Muhammad?
questions.explanation: The first revelation began with 'Iqra' which means 'Read', in Surah Al-Alaq.

questions.question: Which part of the Quran is often called Juz Amma?
questions.explanation: Juz Amma is the 30th juz and includes many short surahs.

questions.question: Which famous verse of protection is verse 255 of Surah Al-Baqarah?
options: The last verse of the Quran
questions.explanation: Ayat al-Kursi (the Verse of the Throne) is verse 255 of Surah Al-Baqarah.

questions.question: How many verses does Surah Al-Kawthar have?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Kawthar has three verses.

questions.question: How many verses are in Surah Al-Ikhlas?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Ikhlas has 4 verses and describes the Oneness of Allah.

questions.question: Over how many years was the Quran revealed?
questions.explanation: The Quran was revealed gradually over about 23 years.

questions.question: What are the rules for reading the Quran beautifully and correctly called?
questions.explanation: Tajweed is the set of rules for pronouncing the Quran correctly and beautifully.

questions.question: Surahs revealed in Mecca are called what?
questions.explanation: Surahs revealed before the Hijrah in Mecca are called Makki Surahs.

questions.question: Which Surah do Muslims recite in every rakat of prayer?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Fatiha is recited in every rakat of every prayer.

questions.question: What is the explanation of the Quran's meaning called?
questions.explanation: Tafsir is the scholarly explanation of the meanings of the Quran.

questions.question: Which two short Surahs are recited for protection and are called 'Al-Mu'awwidhatayn'?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Falaq and Surah An-Nas are the two Surahs of seeking protection with Allah.

questions.question: How many verses are in Surah Al-Baqarah, the longest Surah?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Baqarah has 286 verses, making it the longest Surah in the Quran.

questions.question: Which Surah does NOT begin with Bismillah?
questions.explanation: Surah At-Tawbah (Surah 9) is the only Surah that does not begin with Bismillah.

questions.question: In which Surah is Ayat al-Kursi found, and in which juz?
questions.explanation: Ayat al-Kursi is verse 2:255 in Surah Al-Baqarah, located in juz 3.

questions.question: How many verses does Surah Ya-Sin have?
questions.explanation: Surah Ya-Sin, Surah 36 of the Quran, has 83 verses.

questions.question: In which cave did Prophet Muhammad receive the first revelation?
questions.explanation: Angel Jibril brought the first revelation to Prophet Muhammad in Cave Hira on Jabal an-Nur.

questions.question: Which Surah is named after a woman?
questions.explanation: Surah Maryam (Surah 19) is named after Maryam, the mother of Prophet Isa.

questions.question: Surahs revealed after the Hijrah to Medina are called what?
questions.explanation: Surahs revealed after the migration to Medina are called Madani Surahs.

questions.question: During which month do many Muslims try to finish reading the whole Quran?
questions.explanation: In Ramadan, the month the Quran was revealed, many Muslims read one juz each day to finish all 30.

questions.question: What is Surah Al-Ikhlas mainly about?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Ikhlas declares that Allah is One, eternal, and nothing is like Him.

questions.question: Reciting Surah Al-Ikhlas is said to equal how much of the Quran in reward?
questions.explanation: Prophet Muhammad taught that Surah Al-Ikhlas is equal to one third of the Quran in reward.
